text_block_list.text: I spotted Inari One at a tatami shop in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haaah... The scent of rush grass from brand-new tatami mats is just irresistible. So relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Mind if I pop in for a bit?
Don't worry, I won't get in the way of your work.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Female Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's rare for someone young to like tatami mats.
If you want, why not lie down on this fresh one I just finished?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Well then, don't mind if I do—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Best feeling ever...
All the fatigue is just melting right out of me...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I don't wanna move anymore.
Can't I just crash here for the night...? ...
Inari One seems to be fatigued from her races. It might be wise to reconsider her race schedule.
